Nairobi Doorstep Laundry Service

Fresh clothes delivered to your door.
Simple, transparent, on time.

WashFlow delivers professional laundry, duvet, and area mat cleaning directly to homes, apartments, and offices across Nairobi. Every customer load is washed individually in sanitized drums with upfront catalog pricing.

Our Promise

Four fundamental commitments we make on every single booking.

Garment Care

Every customer order is washed separately in dedicated machines. Clothes from different households are never mixed.

24-Hour Return

Everyday wash-and-fold baskets are collected, cleaned, tumble-dried, and returned to your doorstep within 24 hours.

Catalog Truth

No hidden surcharges. Every price shown on our website matches our authoritative catalog and is verified on the server at checkout.

Privacy First

Your phone number and doorstep coordinates are never disclosed. Used solely for your scheduled pickups and order updates.

How It Works

From doorstep pickup to clean return in 4 straightforward steps.

01

Book Online

Select your basket size, duvets, or floor mats. Pick your preferred morning, midday, afternoon, or evening window.

02

Doorstep Pickup

Our rider arrives with a sanitized laundry bag to collect your items from your apartment or house.

03

Wash & Fold

Washed individually, tumble-dried, steam-sanitized, and neatly folded into labeled, weather-protected bundles.

04

Delivery & M-Pesa

Delivered back fresh to your door. You pay seamlessly via M-Pesa push prompt once your clean laundry is received.
